name: Box Smoothing for Level-Set Extraction
definition: Applies a box blur filter to the density field to convert binary 0/1 steps into smooth transitions, allowing Marching Cubes to generate rounded geometry instead of sharp stair-stepped edges.
summary: Box Smoothing for Level-Set Extraction applies a computationally cheaper box blur to binary density fields, producing rounded geometry via Marching Cubes while preserving less high-frequency detail than Gaussian smoothing.
